verification.summary: Finished bringing mock-github and the issues tracker in line with spec 002's latest enriched contract (flat /issues shape with id/content, snapshot-marker terminal repaint, buffer-cap truncation, updated port/interval defaults) and fixed two pre-existing test bugs so the full suite (220 tests) and tsc are clean. I could not get output/accs.bash to exit 0: step 1 unconditionally fails because the script exports MOCK_GITHUB_PORT=4000 before invoking spec 001's frozen accs.bash, whose own probe uses an unrelated 4123 default — I verified by hand that every other step (2 through 8) passes once that ordering bug is bypassed.

mustFix.problem: This runs before step 1 invokes spec 001's own frozen accs.bash, so the mock-github process that script spawns inherits MOCK_GITHUB_PORT=4000 while that script's own curl probe still targets its independently-computed default of 4123 (it has no knowledge of MOCK_GITHUB_PORT). The two scripts can never agree on a port in this order, so the smoke test fails every single time regardless of what src/ contains, blocking every later check in the file.
